{{recipe}}

Perfect for Dad on Father's Day.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 strip [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|steaks]]
* 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|Black pepper]]
* 2 sprigs [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]]

== Procedure ==
#Rub steaks with garlic on both sides and coat with olive oil.
#Sprinkle steaks with salt and black pepper and place on the highest heat you can get with your [[Cookbook:Grilling|grill]]. Place rosemary on top of each steak.
#[[Cookbook:Searing|Sear]] 2–3 minutes per side and move to medium grill temperature. Cook until internal temperature reaches desired "doneness".
#Let rest 10 minutes; [[Cookbook:Slicing|slice]] thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.

steps.text: Rub steaks with garlic on both sides and coat with olive oil.
Sprinkle steaks with salt and black pepper and place on the highest heat you can get with your grill. Place rosemary on top of each steak.
Sear 2–3 minutes per side and move to medium grill temperature. Cook until internal temperature reaches desired "doneness".
Let rest 10 minutes; slice thinly across the grain on a bias and serve.
